_about: Mission rules for OPSAT STATUS. Every fail condition is taken from the game's own localization (System/dynamic-pc.umd: Lambert lines and objective texts). 'fail' = mission over. 'penalty' = mission continues but objectives are cancelled or rating drops.
general: Primary objectives must be done to finish. Secondary ones carry over to a later mission if failed. Opportunity ones are optional (rating only).
Alarms: stage 1-3 make enemies armor up; stage 4 = general alarm (fight your way out). Failed hacks and cameras sound alarms.
Killing, alarms and detection all lower the Mission Rating.

notes: The guerillas have no alarm system on site.

penalty: The ship has a central alarm system - too many alarms and the crew hunts you.
notes: The crew are armed guerillas, not civilians.

penalty: Destroying a computer you need for the fake emails aborts your opportunity objectives.
Alarm stage 4 = general alarm: the Panamanian Army comes in; finish primaries and get out.
notes: It is a robbery that must look like an inside job - stay ghost.

penalty: Two civilians killed = additional objectives cancelled.
notes: The National Guard is on our side - don't kill any of them.

fail: Kill anyone = mission over (Lambert pulls the plug).
notes: Recon mission: knock out, never kill.

penalty: Two civilians killed = only primaries remain.
Alarms push the base to full alert - you are on the edge of World War Three.

fail: Killing the men you must interrogate = mission over. Talk to them first.

penalty: Civilian kills are tracked - two and Lambert cancels extras.
Two civilians killed = all objectives except primaries aborted.
notes: Semi-public place: civilians in the baths, Shetland's men everywhere.

fail: Any fatality = mission over (a dead Japanese soldier risks World War Three).
notes: No enemy means no kills. Knock out only, and get downed officers medical attention in time.
